purpose: Bounded grouped-holdout comparison of frozen external representations against the frozen production CNN and a statistical ephemeris baseline on real labeled cache-local Kepler signals

population.selection_rule: Within the corpus's predefined train, val, and test splits, retain the lexically lowest source_row_id per KIC, then select the lowest SHA-256 of selection_seed plus group_key independently within each split and label.

preprocessing.cadence_filter: finite TIME and PDCSAP_FLUX, positive PDCSAP_FLUX, QUALITY equals zero
preprocessing.folding: Committed period_days and epoch_bjd; phase range [-0.5, 0.5)
preprocessing.binning: Median physical flux per phase bin with circular interpolation of missing bins

probe.test_access: one versioned opening after all feature, probe, threshold, and decision rules are frozen
probe.threshold_rule: Maximum validation F1 with ties broken toward the higher threshold
probe.external_adds_value_rule: At least one frozen external representation must exceed the better of both required comparators by at least 0.01 on at least one precommitted decision metric.

parallel_shape.model_inference: serialized within each shard with one ONNX thread per session

storage.temporary_embeddings: Compressed shard-local arrays under ignored logs/; deleted only after successful aggregate evidence is written.
storage.persistent_output: Small JSON shard summaries, aggregate evidence, and Run Reports only.

limitations: The balanced frozen subset is a capability benchmark, not a deployment-prevalence sample; its false-discovery rate is sample-conditional.
Periods and epochs come from the labeled DR25 corpus, so this gate measures representation quality after candidate ephemerides exist rather than blind search performance.
One signal per KIC prevents group leakage but omits multi-signal system behavior.
A PASS is descriptive scientific evidence only and does not authorize model training, broad embedding extraction, checkpoint promotion, or production scoring changes.
